purpose: Separate actual GPU static operator witness for the explicit-gravity error, not a replacement for the retained variable_coarse endpoint rejection and not a trajectory/physical/public/wall admission.

immutable_include.reuse: One main rename/one AppInfo; neutral Check/Fresh and existing project includes. The old main/solver/reader is never called. No endpoint.cpp/gravity.cpp nested include and no new CNG or libraries.

execution_protocol: Two independent future owned invocations/fresh objects, one constant and one variable. This source executes only its explicitly selected model, never chains jobs or launches a historical solver. Each run has one fresh output directory and protects existing paths. Author did not execute either.
retained_input: The same constant coarse initial seed/runtime as the private periodic gravity fixture, outputs/upl_gravity_periodic_seed_r1/CaseGravity_c.{xml,bi4}. Seed initial BI4 loading is required by actual fresh initialization; no saved PART file is read. Runtime material/geometry/options/clock are checked unchanged; both gravity declarations are (-8,0,0); all public master/model/Ck keys stay explicitly zero. Future external wrapper must hash-bind exact seed/program/source/runtime before and after.

manufactured_state.formula: J_i=1+delta*sin(2*pi*X_i/Lx), where X_i is the retained native initial x; delta is fixed a priori, not searched or fitted.
manufactured_state.fields: Initial positions/ID/cell geometry are not moved. Set p,p0,effective sigma,velocity XYZ,theta,plastic and load acceleration to exact zero, passive legacy rho to2048. Constant and variable models receive identical manufactured J/fields; only private conductivity flag/Ck differs.
manufactured_state.ownership: Assign J to all current slots by the actual unique normal-fluid owner ID, then call actual RunCellDivide(true) once to retire/regenerate/sort periodic images. Verify exact same normal positions by ID and every resulting slot's owner J. Zero manufactured fields across the rebuilt slot set, including plastic, before force. This does not claim a periodic plastic-copy requirement.
manufactured_state.interpretation: A frozen lattice with manufactured local J weights; not a constitutively evolved globally compatible deformation. Actual force must naturally give Ace=0/theta=0, hence physical solid acceleration is Ace+g=g. It is a conditional freefall operator input, not hydrostatic balance or physical truth.

actual_lifecycle: Fresh JSphGpuSingle: select device/timers,LoadConfig,LoadCaseParticles,VisuConfig,ConfigDomain,ConfigRunMode,InitRunGpu,FreePartsInit. Private Observer/Feedback/complete-pressure flags enabled, optional smooth law only in constructor. No Run,ComputeStep,SaveData,PART read/restart or time advancement. No manual force-stat maxima; their first read is after the real force.

natural_force.sentinel: Fill every rebuilt rate slot with finite float123.25 before force and each negative rate call; require every actual rate slot overwritten.
natural_force.strict_zero: For all512 normal owners actual Ace XYZ,actual theta,actual rate and independently assembled Gp/rate/q must be numerically exactly zero (not a tolerance); p/v/stress/load input fields and J/positions/IDs remain bit-exact. Physical acceleration must equal g exactly. A failure remains a failure; do not relax after results.
natural_force.owners: After natural force and both wrong-Ace calls, every actual periodic slot's J/C/Ace/theta/rate is byte-equal to the unique normal-fluid owner. C is generated by the actual force/free-surface stage, never copied from a stale prior trajectory.

independent_general_reference.search: Host O(N^2) all actual downloaded native+periodic fluid slots with actual double positions, float support/eta2 and actual kernel-header Fac(CSP,float(r^2)); conditional on the actual stage C/Ace/theta.
independent_general_reference.formula: Vj=V0*Jj; gi=Ci*gradW,gj=Cj*gradW; wij=Vj*d·(gi+gj)/(r^2+eta2); lp=sum wij(pi-pj),lx=sum wij*d,Gp=-sum Vj(pi-pj)gi,GJ=sum Vj(Jj-Ji)gi,divAce=sum Vj(Acej-Acei)·gi. B=Kw/n(J); alpha=0 or1/((1-n0)Ck); rate=B[-theta+k/gamma(lp-Gp·lx+rhow*divAce)+(alpha*k)/gamma GJ·(Gp+rhow*Acei)].
independent_general_reference.budget: For EACH natural/wrong side independently recompute the full existing general raw-majorant, not a pre-assumed zero majorant:64*FLT_EPSILON*raw+256*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,|B*theta|)+1e-6 Pa/s. Raw includes all absolute lp pairs,Gp/lx correction,divAce pairs and smooth-chain terms. No tolerance change, fitted bounds or omitted side terms.
independent_general_reference.conditioning_limit: This tests actual rate assembly and owned extension conditional on actual C/Ace/theta, with stricter manufactured natural-zero assertions; not an independent general proof of C or mechanical force construction.
independent_general_reference.q: Derived conditional q=-k/gamma(Gp+rhow*Ace), not a saved native flux or a face/water-balance test.

actual_negative_sides.protocol: After the natural actual force, replace Ace across all slots with -g then +g, leaving theta0 and other manufactured inputs unchanged. For EACH side call actual PrepareDynamicPorePeriodicGpu(), then actual ComputeDynamicPorePressureRateGpu(map), which consumes the owner map and extends actual C/Ace/theta/rate. These are real complete-rate kernel calls, not formula-only counterfactuals or extra force calls. Actual side Ace is asserted exact, and each side rate is compared to its own independent general reference under its unchanged original raw budget.
actual_negative_sides.formula_delta: With strict natural Gp/Ace/theta/rate0, the incorrect explicit +/-g signal is +/-B/gamma*(alpha*k)*rhow*(GJ dot g). Independently assembled side-minus-base reference must agree with this formula within max(base,side) original budget; the actual side is separately checked against its general reference.
actual_negative_sides.nonempty: Variable: on EACH sign, at least one normal owner must satisfy min(|actual_side-base_actual|,|reference_side-base_reference|)>100*max(base_budget,side_budget). This is no weaker than the original100-budget criterion and protects against shrinking a side budget. Constant: actual and reference side rates and formula delta must be strict zero; nonempty signal is exempt only for alpha0.
actual_negative_sides.restoration: After EACH side, restore natural Ace/rate/cache byte-exact, require unchanged C/theta and manufactured inputs/clock/fixed-dt telemetry. A failed side also attempts restoration before scratch cleanup. No original trajectory/state/result is loaded or modified.

cache_scales_safety: On natural actual force only, compare the actual coefficient-gradient cache to native max[B/gamma*alpha*k*|GJ|] under original64FLT_EPS*max(1,reference); constant cache strictly0. Independently compute current-J max cu^2 and current-k diffusion, strict positive-k RH margin64DBL_EPS*max(rho,rhow), wave/pore relative64DBL_EPS, and original necessary minimum of CFL/acceleration/wave,pore,safety*h/uk. Require declared dt and DtMin inside bound. Modified-Ace negative calls are rate operators, not fresh mechanical forces; no false negative-side acceleration-stat scale claim.

outputs.rates.csv: 1536 rows=model selected,natural512 plus actual Ace_minus_g512 and Ace_plus_g512. Coordinates are unchanged initial/material positions, not displaced trajectory coordinates; contains actual/reference rates, full raw/budget/Gp/GJ/Ace/theta/conditional q/formula+actual deltas.
outputs.summary.csv: 3 rows, natural/minus/plus, actual/reference cache, maximum rate error and stronger sensitivity ratio, owner counts.
outputs.completion.json: Only written after all selected-model gates pass; required fields passed,model,actual_endpoint_force_calls1,actual_negative_complete_rate_calls2,native_count512,physical_steps_advanced0,physical_acceptancefalse. Contains restoration/owner counts/scales and explicit limits.
outputs.Run.out: Actual fresh initialization log, not a completed solver trajectory.

external_proof: Future owned wrapper must bind current source/build110objects/helper/tool/lib/runtime/canonical identities,exact initial XML/BI4,typed owned exit and Debug memcheck0errors/0leaks. Component contains no SHA/CNG or ownership proof. Normal exit is not physical admission.
historical_failure: Keep outputs/logs upl_gpu_gravity_endpoint_variable_coarse_r1 unchanged and failed. A successful new static operator witness cannot retroactively supply its missing >100 trajectory witness, supersede its failure or automatically admit half/Init/walls.
